items.statement: The workflow establishes a converged neutral-singlet ground-state stationary point and uses vibrational analysis to determine whether it is a minimum.
items.expected: A ground-state geometry and frequency evidence are supplied, with the minimum claim tied to the submitted frequencies and diagnostics.

items.statement: The S1→S0 CPL transition is explicitly assigned and both electric and magnetic transition dipoles plus their angle are obtained from the excited-state calculation.
items.expected: The report identifies S1, gives provenance for the transition dipoles and angle, and connects them to the CPL calculation.

items.statement: The calculated C[2]BNDI CPL dissymmetry magnitude is approximately 7.1 × 10−3.
